messages:
mei: hey team — trying to pull APAC model-health dashboard for a customer sync in 30m. i can’t open the dashboard link that the doc references, getting a 403. can someone share the shortlink or grant view perms? :wave:
rohan: which dashboard exactly? service overview or model-health per-region?
mei: the region-level model-health (latency/p95, error-rate, kv-cache hit). url in the doc is old. just need something I can screenshot quickly.
platform-jen: pinging grafana access team. quick workaround: this shortlink should work for read-only: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abC123/model-health-apac?orgId=1  — if that 403s you probably need the "observability-view" role in IAM.
mei: tried the shortlink, still 403. i don’t see the observability-view role in my profile.
sre-bot: Access request template: please post your email + requested role + justification. Example:
```
user: mei@redwood.ai
role: observability-view
reason: customer sync — need APAC model health dashboard screenshots and traces for incident followup
```
platform-jen: mei can you paste the template here and i'll escalate with infra. also, if you need a specific panel image, tell me which metric so i can export quickly.
mei: thanks. pasted below:
```
user: mei@redwood.ai
role: observability-view
reason: customer sync at 14:30 PT, need region model-health, p95 and kv-cache panels
```
platform-jen: done — elevated to infra with high priority. @luis can you also grab the p95+kv panels and drop PNGs while access is processed? :eyes: 
luis: on it. grabbing panels now. for traces, look in Loki with this query for APAC model runtime errors:
```
{job="model-runtime"} |= "error" | json | line_format "{{.timestamp}} {{.level}} {{.msg}}"
```
rohan: small note for future: alerts for APAC model p95 are on a rolling window that sometimes spikes during nightly backups — we should tune threshold or add a suppression window. happy to open an alert-tune ticket after the sync.
mei: perfect — pngs and traces would be amazing. thanks y’all. :thumbsup:
luis: uploaded 3 PNGs to the thread (panels: p95 latency, kv-cache-hit, 5xx rate) — linking: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/1923456789/panels.zip
platform-jen: infra approved observability-view for mei@redwood.ai, should be live in ~2m — refresh your grafana.
mei: confirmed, i can access the dashboard now. grabbing screenshots and joining the call.
rohan: noted the alert tuning item; will create ticket ENG-OBS-427 to track suppression for nightly backup windows.
mei: awesome, thanks everyone — saved the day.
